description: Source code for content decoding tool in the net namespace, implementing stream processing for various content encodings like gzip, deflate, and brotli, including a class for reading from stdin and a function to process input streams with specified encodings.

classes.name: StdinSourceStream
classes.description: A SourceStream implementation that reads data from an std::istream, used for feeding data into the decoding pipeline.

methods.name: ContentDecoderToolProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input stream data with specified content encodings, decoding them in reverse order, and writes the decoded data to an output stream.
